title: Documentation Foundation - docs/ 目录结构搭建

requirements: Create 6 subdirectories: [docs/features/, docs/guides/, docs/services/, docs/notes/, docs/versions/, docs/assets/]
Create 1 documentation index file: docs/README.md (目录导航页，列出所有文档链接)
Create 1 documentation sidebar config: docs/_sidebar.md (侧边栏导航结构)
Reference 音流项目 6 大板块: [intro, features, services, guides, notes, versions]
acceptance: 1 root directory created: verify by ls docs/ (exists)
6 subdirectories created: verify by ls -d docs/*/ | wc -l = 6
1 index file created: verify by test -f docs/README.md && echo ok
1 sidebar file created: verify by test -f docs/_sidebar.md && echo ok
Index file contains links to all 6 sections: verify by grep -c '\[' docs/README.md >= 6

conventions: Chinese content with English technical terms

pre_analysis.action: Verify no existing docs/ directory or documentation files
